The text says the number fell from a value ('a high of 14.5 million'), so (Source sk_fall_1 sk_group_apr) states a falsehood — the origin of the decline is a numeric level, not the set of households.
Same falsehood in the Goal slot — a household group is not the value the number fell to — and it silently picks one of two coordinated endpoints.

Core patterns' 'assert only what the text states' test fails: no word in 'according to NPD' puts (Member npd company) there, and the proper-noun rule requires only the Name fact unless the text states a kind.

The sentence contains no comparative, so the ordering is inferred rather than stated (Core patterns), and Comparatives requires the scale to be the surface adjective — the quantity comparative uses the stated poles few/many, never an unstated 'quantity'.
Same defect on the May-vs-June pair: an unstated comparative on an unlicensed 'quantity' scale.

(Past sk_acquire_1/2/3) is true of a past-tense report about April-June and well-typed; the rules that withhold tense from non-finite eventualities (control and causative complements, temporal-anchor event nouns) all concern events whose occurrence is NOT asserted, whereas a reduced relative's event is asserted, and the reduced-relative rule itself says nothing about tense.

gaps_confirmed: 'the number of Ns' as a quantity-denoting subject NP — the of-phrase is neither genitive, partitive, measure-of nor nominalization-object, and nothing makes the number itself the predicated thing

change in a measured quantity over time ('fell from 14.5 million to 12.7 million and 10.4 million') — Measure/More/MoreBy compare entities on a scale; nothing encodes one quantity moving between successive values
attribution / evidential 'according to <source>' as a construction scoping a whole proposition
'a high of N' — a peak/extremum value as the starting point of a decline
new_gaps: an ordering that follows from stated figures (April > May > June) has no licensed record — the comparative section requires a stated comparative, which is exactly what pushed the parser into the invented (More quantity ...) atoms
Source/Goal take entity fillers only, so even a single numeric endpoint of a decline has nothing well-typed to occupy the slot
